meta.title: Product | Green Ecolution | Measure. Understand. Act.
meta.description: Green Ecolution is a modular, open-source platform that turns readings into decisions and deployments. Today it controls the demand-based irrigation of urban trees.

hero.label: Product
hero.headline: Measure. Understand. Act.
hero.description: Green Ecolution is a modular, open-source platform. Sensors deliver readings, the platform turns them into a clear picture of the situation, and deployment planning sends your team exactly where it is needed. Today it controls the irrigation of urban trees, and that is only the beginning.

dashboard.description: Our system scientifically evaluates the sensor data and shows when irrigation is needed. The data is prepared so that it is easy to interpret and can be directly incorporated into deployment planning.
dashboard.imageAlt: Green Ecolution dashboard - overview of irrigation recommendations

process.title: Three steps, one system
process.description: Measure, understand and act stay the same for every task. The irrigation of urban trees is the first example.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: Sensors capture what is happening on site and transmit their readings energy-efficiently via LoRaWAN or NB-IoT. For irrigation, soil probes measure moisture and temperature at variable depths.

details.item2: Soil moisture and temperature at variable depths
details.item3: Energy-efficient transmission via LoRaWAN or NB-IoT
details.item4: Flush-mounted installation, no impact on maintenance work

understand.title: Understand
understand.description: The platform evaluates the measurement series and shows on a map and dashboard where action is needed. For irrigation, a traffic-light system shows which trees and areas need water.

details.item1: Traffic-light system shows irrigation needs on a map
details.item2: Prioritization by urgency when capacity is limited
details.item3: Time series for soil moisture, temperature, and water tension
details.item4: Real-time dashboard with all relevant KPIs

act.title: Act
act.description: The picture of the situation becomes a deployment. Deployment and route planning generates routes that take vehicles, capacities and road restrictions into account. For irrigation, these are watering routes with refill stops.

details.item2: Takes water capacity and vehicle size into account
details.item4: Export of routes to navigation devices

architecture.title: The path of the data
architecture.description: This is how the readings travel from the sensor to the finished route. Every component is connected through open interfaces and can be extended.
architecture.streamletRich: Route optimisation in the backend is handled by <streamlet>Streamlet</streamlet>, a separate service of ours that can also be used outside Green Ecolution.

sensor.label: Sensor
sensor.description: Measures on site, for example the soil moisture at the tree

plugin.title: Plugin system
plugin.description: Modular extensions for municipality-specific adaptations without changing the core software. Import plugins for tree registries, CSV, and databases.

api.title: API-first
api.description: Open interfaces for integration into municipal IT landscapes. Connection to IoT hubs and open data portals.

beyond.title: Beyond irrigation
beyond.p1: The irrigation of urban trees is the first use case we built Green Ecolution for. The platform itself is conceived more broadly: wherever something can be measured, the readings have to be evaluated and a deployment on site follows in the end, the principle of measuring, understanding and acting applies.
beyond.p2: The architecture is designed to take on further sensor types and use cases. A new use case still means development work, for example to connect the sensors and evaluate the data. We take care of that work for you.
beyond.ctaAriaLabel: To the page with our services

requirements.title: What you need for it
requirements.lead: Getting started is smaller than it first looks. The four points describe what has to come from the municipality.
requirements.sensorsOptionalNote: Scheduling and route planning already work without sensors. Trees, fleet and refill points are enough. The soil probes improve the prioritisation because they show which areas actually need water.

treeData.label: Tree and area data
treeData.description: Locations come in via CSV import or by connecting an existing tree register. There is no need to build a register from scratch.

fleet.label: The fleet you already have
fleet.description: Water carts, vans and trailers with their water capacities, plus the refill points across the city. A new fleet or fixed irrigation hardware is not required.

network.label: A radio link for the sensors
network.description: The probes transmit over LoRaWAN and the open The Things Network today. Since 2024 Schleswig-Holstein has built a state-wide network with more than 420 gateways. Where there is no coverage, you can either add a gateway of your own or run the same probes on NB-IoT with a SIM card. LoRaWAN is the technology in use today, not a condition.

hosting.label: Someone to run the platform
hosting.description: We run the platform for you, including updates, backups and support. Because the source code is open and free of licence fees, running it yourself stays possible at any time. So you are not tied to us, and you still do not have to look after any of it.

requirements.tourLinkRich: How the route optimisation works and what input it expects is described on the <streamlet>route optimisation</streamlet> page.

advantages.title: All other features and advantages
advantages.description: Green Ecolution is publicly viewable and pursues one goal: using resources where they are needed. For irrigation, that means less water and variable deployment planning.

openSource.title: An open solution for everyone
openSource.description: Auditable source code, no licence fees and no vendor lock-in

optimizedRoutes.title: Optimized routes
optimizedRoutes.description: Individual deployment planning for more efficient irrigation

vision.title: Made for every municipality
vision.descriptionPart1: The platform is deliberately designed to be usable in any municipality and for more than one task. Map areas, organisational structures and deployment areas are freely configurable, and new components connect through the plugin system and open interfaces.
vision.descriptionPart2: Only open standards and open-source components are used. A cloud-native architecture based on Kubernetes enables multi-tenant, highly available operation. Additional municipalities can easily be added.

mediaFeature.title: Green Ecolution on the Schleswig-Holstein Magazin
mediaFeature.description: In August 2026 public broadcaster NDR reported on urban trees that no longer survive the dry summers and spent a morning filming in Flensburg. The piece shows a soil moisture sensor going into the ground and how the city's technical operations centre plans the next watering run from its readings.
mediaFeature.posterAlt: View up into an oak canopy with the sun flaring through the leaves, the Schleswig-Holstein Magazin logo in the bottom left corner
